name: incremental-and-qa-plan-plugin
description: Create and continue coherent incremental plans with QA design by default, or design standalone QA plans, with independent review and evidence-based handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Plan coherent increments with QA, or standalone QA work.
interface.longDescription: Turn authoritative plans into coherent increments with QA design by default or explicit supplementary-QA exclusion. Reconcile executor evidence, or design standalone QA and warranted certification work from a plan, project or both. Prepare evidence-aware handoffs without executing product work.
defaultPrompt: Turn my implementation plan into coherent increments with QA design.
Design standalone QA and verification work from my plan or project.
